Chesky made the remarks in an interview on the Silicon Valley Girl Podcast, published on Oct. 1. He said he felt like "the luckiest person alive" because he arrived in Silicon Valley at 26, when the iPhone had just launched and cloud computing meant "you could have an app and not have to buy your own servers."
He remembered saying for years, "thank god I was born the time I did because now is a tougher time," until the launch of generative AI. After that, he said, "part of me said, I wish I was 26 again."

Chesky said that if he were 26, "I could probably do something just as cool because the tools now are so much more powerful." He said he is "very interested in education" and thinks "AI can transform education." He also said, "you could build an AI Disney, you could create incredible storytelling with AI," and, "I think health is like an incredible area."
